newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cairn has 78 pct of Command, md Doran resigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cairn has 78 pct of Command, md Doran resigns.

text.p: Command Petroleum Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that Cairn Energy Plc held 78.11 percent of its issued capital and three Cairn representatives had joined the board, replacing directors appointed by former key shareholder Snyder Oil Corp.
The Sydney-based oil explorer, which is the operator of the Ravva oilfield off the Indian coast, also said managing director Dr John Doran had been replaced by Command executive Bun C. Hung.
Doran will remain on the board of Command until December 15.
Cairn's cash offer of A$1.10 a share closes on Thursday and values Command at A$354.5 million.
Command shares closed one cent lower at A$1.09 on turnover of 1.68 million shares.
